environment.description: Terraform provider runs on an EC2 instance in a public subnet (10.0.1.0/24) with an Internet Gateway attached. The instance has a public IP and unrestricted outbound security group rules (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports). The GraphQL API endpoint is an internal service at graphql.internal.corp:8080. The provider is executed via terraform apply by a CI/CD pipeline with broad IAM permissions. No query validation or WAF is deployed in front of the GraphQL service.
